newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks end lower despite strong May output.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks end lower despite strong May output.

text.p: Tokyo stocks closed lower on Friday after a brief rally prompted by stronger-than-expected growth in Japan's industrial production in May fizzled out due to caution on the peak day for annual shareholders' meetings, brokers said.
The mixed forecasts for output in coming months that accompanied the production data also watered down buying momentum, they said.
The 225-share Nikkei average ended down 101.01 points, or 0.49 percent, at 20,523.75 having hit a high of 20,742.67.
